legal_units.title: Relief from taxation in income from retirement benefit account maintained in a notified country.
legal_units.text: "specified account" means an account maintained in a notified country by the specified person for his retirement benefits, the income from which is taxed by that notified country at the time of withdrawal or redemption and, not on accrual basis;

Section 158(2): For the purposes of this section,— Section 158(2)(b): "specified account" means an account maintained in a notified country by the specified person for his retirement benefits, the income from which is taxed by that notified country at the time of withdrawal or redemption and, not on accrual basis;

legal_units.title: Relief from taxation in income from retirement benefit account maintained in a notified country.
legal_units.text: "specified person" means a person resident in India having opened a specified account in a notified country while being non-resident in India and resident in that country.
